safepaths.gui.server_config: This server's settings are managed by its owner. Edit config/safepaths-common.toml on the server.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.safepaths: Create paths by walking over ground. Configure road speed and let unused paths return to their original terrain. MineColonies support is optional.
neoforge.screen.mods.info.description.sa: Create paths by walking over ground. Configure road speed and let unused paths return to their original terrain. MineColonies support is optional.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.safepaths: Create paths by walking over ground. Configure road speed and let unused paths return to their original terrain. MineColonies support is optional.
safepaths.configuration.title: Safepaths Settings
safepaths.configuration.Path Settings.to: Configure path creation and speed boost behavior
safepaths.gui.conversions.title: Path Conversions
safepaths.gui.conversions.hint: Select a row, then choose blocks.
safepaths.gui.palette.title: Block Palette (Click to select)
safepaths.gui.add_conversion.tooltip: Add a new custom source block -> road block conversion entry
safepaths.gui.restore_defaults.title: Restore Default Conversions
safepaths.gui.restore_defaults.message: Are you sure you want to restore default conversions? Any custom block entries will be reset.
config.safepaths.requiredPasses.tooltip: Passes needed to form a path. Standing still or jumping in place does not add passes.
config.safepaths.constructionTime.toolti: Time from the first counted step to reach the required passes. Later steps do not extend it. 24,000 ticks is one Minecraft day.
config.safepaths.enableSpeedBoost.toolti: Give living entities a movement speed bonus on recognized roads.
config.safepaths.speedMultiplier.tooltip: Movement speed bonus on roads. 0.2 adds 20%; 0 disables the bonus.
config.safepaths.decayTime.tooltip: Ticks without authorized traffic before a tracked path restores its original terrain. 72,000 ticks is three Minecraft days.
config.safepaths.customConversions.toolt: Source block -> path block. Use the same block on both sides for a permanent speed road.
